lines.text: Many learners say: I am living here since 2020.
Better: I have lived here since 2020.
Have lived! I have lived here since May.

native.tip: हिंदी में “2020 से रह रहा हूँ” कहते हैं, पर अंग्रेज़ी में since के साथ “have lived” आता है।
native.caption: क्या आप भी कहते हैं “I am living here since 2020”? 😉 अंग्रेज़ी में “I have lived here since 2020” सही है, क्योंकि since के साथ have + क्रिया का तीसरा रूप चलता है। Carlos की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर: “have lived”। “am living” की जगह “have lived” बोलें। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: Hindi says “2020 se reh raha hoon”, but English uses “have lived” with since.
en.caption: Do you say “I am living here since 2020”? 😉 In English “I have lived here since 2020” is right, because since goes with have plus the past form. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
